spec: §15 suite H (reproducibility); §11 obligations: the schedule must be reproducible from the request plus scheduler version; §9.2 schedule_hash = SHA-256 of the schedule's JCS bytes
derivation: Two requests identical except for whitespace-equivalent encodings of one decimal must canonicalise to the same schedule bytes and hence the same schedule_hash; a consumer validates the binding schedule_hash against the bytes it received.
